disclaimer.title: Before you use the Drug Reference
disclaimer.intro: This tool shows general health information from official FDA drug labels and matches symptoms to over-the-counter options. It is provided for information only.
disclaimer.notAdvice: It is not medical advice and not a substitute for a doctor, pharmacist, or nurse.
disclaimer.notChecker: It is not a drug-interaction checker. Always read each product’s full label and check with a professional before combining medicines.
disclaimer.matches: Situation matches come from label text, not clinical recommendations — they can be incomplete or include products you wouldn’t expect.
disclaimer.followProduct: Always follow the directions on the actual product you have; dosages and warnings differ between products.
disclaimer.emergency: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe, worsening, or you’re unsure, contact a medical professional or call emergency services.
disclaimer.source: Data is from openFDA (U.S. FDA, public domain). NOMAD is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA.

column.noInteractionText: No labeled interaction text on this label.

ingest.dlFailed: The download failed — it retries automatically; if it stays failed, press "Download FDA data" to restart. Finished parts are kept and resume where they left off.
ingest.dlCompleted: All parts are on disk. Indexing them into search next.
ingest.dlRunningParts: Pulling part {{part}} of {{total}} — ~1.7 GB total across all parts.
ingest.ingFailed: Indexing failed — press "Ingest into search" to retry from the downloaded files (no re-download). Already-indexed labels are kept (the refresh is idempotent).
ingest.ingRunningParts: Writing part {{part}} of {{total}} into the offline database.
ingest.ingRunningNoParts: Writing labels into the offline database.
ingest.background: Runs in the background — you can leave this page and it keeps going. Search turns on automatically when ingest finishes.

show.interactionsFootnote: Single-drug label information — not a cross-drug interaction checker
show.footerSource: Source: U.S. Food & Drug Administration drug labeling, via openFDA — public domain (CC0 1.0). NOMAD is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA.
show.footerNoRely: Do not rely on this data to make decisions regarding medical care. While every effort is made to ensure accuracy, you should assume all results are unvalidated.

interactions.subtitle: View each drug's FDA-labeled interaction warnings side by side. Select up to {{max}} drugs.
interactions.disclaimer: This shows each drug's own FDA-labeled interaction warnings, individually. It is not a cross-drug interaction checker and is not a substitute for professional medical review. Absence of text here does not mean a drug is safe to combine.
interactions.emptyBody: Download the openFDA drug-label dataset to enable offline search and comparison.
interactions.goDownload: Go to Drug Reference to download data
interactions.searchPlaceholder: Search for a drug to add…
interactions.selectAbove: Select drugs above to compare their labeled interaction warnings.
interactions.footer: Source: U.S. Food & Drug Administration drug labeling, via openFDA — public domain (CC0 1.0). NOMAD is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA. Label data is provided as-is; do not rely on it for medical decisions.

index.confirmRestart: Restart the ingest? This clears the current (possibly stuck) ingest job and re-runs it from the already-downloaded files.
index.emptyBody: Download the openFDA drug-label dataset to enable offline search. Requires ~1.7 GB compressed download (~8–10 GB after ingestion).
index.searchPlaceholder: Search a medicine by name — ibuprofen, Benadryl, loratadine…
index.typeToSearch: Type a medicine name above to search {{formatted}} FDA drug labels.
index.lookingForSymptom: Looking for something to treat a symptom instead? Try the <tab>By situation</tab> tab.
index.pickAbove: Pick a situation (or a few) above to see the over-the-counter drugs whose FDA labels list it.
index.noSingleOption: No single option treats all {{count}} of these — here are options for each situation.
index.noAdditional: No additional OTC options found for {{label}}.
index.labelsInstalled: {{formatted}} drug labels installed. Updating re-checks openFDA for a newer dataset and refreshes the offline copy.
index.pageIntro: Look up a medicine by name, or start from a symptom to find over-the-counter options — all from offline FDA drug labels.
index.footer: Source: U.S. Food & Drug Administration drug labeling, via openFDA — public domain (CC0 1.0). NOMAD is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA. Label data and situation matches are label-text only; do not rely on them for medical decisions.

conditions.noDataBody: Download the offline FDA drug labels from Drug Reference to see matches for this situation.
conditions.noOtcMatch: No over-the-counter drugs match “{{label}}” in the current label data. Try searching by drug name in <link>Drug Reference</link>.
conditions.sources: Sources: NCCIH “Herbs at a Glance” (NIH) and US-government health guidance (CDC, MedlinePlus/NLM, FDA). Public domain (US government works).
conditions.footerSource: Source: U.S. Food & Drug Administration drug labeling, via openFDA — public domain (CC0 1.0). NOMAD is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA.
conditions.footerMatches: Matches are FDA label-indication text, not medical recommendations. Do not rely on this data to make decisions regarding medical care.

remedyNote.title: Informational only — not medical advice.
remedyNote.body: These remedies have limited or mixed evidence, are not FDA-evaluated, and are not a substitute for professional care. Check with a clinician before using any of them, and before combining one with a medication you already take.
remedyNote.emergency: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe or worsening, seek real medical care — call emergency services.

safetyBanner.title: Informational reference only — not medical advice.
safetyBanner.matches: These results match FDA drug-label indications to a situation. They are not a recommendation and not an FDA endorsement.
safetyBanner.notChecker: This is not a drug-interaction checker. Read each label’s full warnings, and check with a pharmacist or clinician before combining medicines.
safetyBanner.emergency: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe or worsening, contact a medical professional or call emergency services.
